source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1961, p. 7 ("Two new members on Larne Rural Council")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: votes and majorities read in the News-Letter report of 3 June 1961; the News-Letter of 2 June had held the Larne results over.

note: Triennial election of Larne Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961; the results were announced on 2 June. Three divisions were contested (Eden, Glynn and Ardclinis) and two women, Miss Martha Sayers and Mrs. Margaret Beckwith, were returned unopposed; the divisions they were returned for are not stated in the reports read. Mr. Victor R. Ledlie withdrew on 17 May and Mrs. Beckwith was returned for Glenarm North. Rea, a former member of Larne Borough Council, gained the seat from the sitting member Mr. A. S. Hunter.
